During NCL, in addition to ligation junction selection 14 , general improvement and optimization in peptide solubility, separation of ligated and un-ligated products, strategic protection and deprotection designs/methods have led to significant improvement in the final product yield, but as we work with many different polymerase variants with varying aa sequences, data-driven systematic optimization process tailored for ‘tough’ aa sequence regions must be derived and able to be utilized in a predictable manner.
